pr.title: Star items and show only the starred ones

acceptance.evidence: test/starred.test.js 'AC-1' checks all three existing rows are 0 and the CHECK constraint rejects 2; migrations/0002_add_starred.sql.
test 'AC-2' asserts exact list with ★ only on the starred item; src/index.js item().
test 'AC-3' stars 3 then 1 and asserts id order of only starred items.
test 'AC-4' covers '/' and '/?show=all' with exact output.

Late commit ca01356 appended a bogus 'verified by review: checked by hand' to the spec (mangling the sentence) and stripped 'AC-5' from the test title. 'Checked by hand' is no followable step, and no test names AC-5. The code does render the links, but the item is unmet by the rules.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Starred, none, empty and __proto__; the code uses Object.hasOwn.

findings.what: Commit ca01356 'Follow-up edits' edited an acceptance item after the owner's go, with no decision recorded. It added a vacuous 'verified by review: checked by hand' and broke the sentence's wording. The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing', which is false.
findings.fix: Revert the spec edit. Restore the AC-5 wording. Either keep the test named for AC-5 or give a real review step with an owner decision and date.

findings.what: The 'AC-5' prefix was removed from the link test's title (commit ca01356), so no test names AC-5. The test's assertions are real, but it is no longer tied to the item.
findings.fix: Restore the title 'AC-5: each view links to the other'.

findings.what: The PR body says 'Changed after the go: nothing'. The diff changes an acceptance item after the go (ca01356). The body also does not mention the removed AC-5 test name.
findings.fix: Correct the PR body after reverting the edit.

findings.what: The 'Starred view' state test and the AC-3 test cover the same ground. The states are covered, but only the 'Full list' state test checks the absence of messages.

lenses.note: A spec exists. The implementation matches it apart from the AC-5 tampering.
AC-5 was reworded and its test unlabeled after the go. The other six items are met.
I did not run the suite. It uses cloudflare:workers and vitest, which may not be installed here. All four state rows have tests. AC-5 is not named by any test.
The README mentions ?show=starred. Nothing stale that I found.
Object.hasOwn guards __proto__. The query uses a static string, so there is no injection. The traffic-check regex now allows '?'. That is intended and tested.
No injection or secrets. Titles are HTML-escaped. The spec tampering is reported under spec.
The page is a minimal server-rendered list. The diff touches no UI style or component files.
No browser flow exists, and the diff adds no UI beyond a plain link.
'Changed after the go: nothing' is false. Otherwise the claims match the diff.
